title: One Seamless Workflow With Clo-Set: Web Techpack
description:
CLO-SET is a cloud-based platform that enables users to collaborate easily with the entire clothing-making process through 3D file management, sharing, and real-time communication.

Turn your design into a production-ready tech pack — from POM to BOM, built in CLO and managed in CLO-SET.

- Visit CLO-SET https://style.clo-set.com/aboutus
- Join Discord: https://discord.com/invite/G2eaK3PDSu
- For any questions, visit https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
transcript: In this lesson, we will learn how to prepare your design for production using WebTechPak in Clow and Closet. First, we will enter the necessary data in the Clow software. In the 2D viewer, select monochrome surface. Then, click the point of measure button on the right panel. Enter the description for the POM and select the measurement points directly on the pattern. You can activate the 3D window at the bottom right to check whether the created POM is correctly displayed on the 3D garment. Next, select seam allowance to input the relevant information. Choose the pattern, adjust the width value for the selected area, and define the seam type. Once completed, switch to print layout, and perform nesting to align the marker paper efficiently. Adjust the settings in nest settings, then click nest patterns all. This allows you to check fabric consumption. Next, go to the production tab at the top, and select build. Next, go to the production tab at the top, and select build. of materials. Then, enter the unit price for each material. After completing all inputs, upload the version to Closet. In the Closet content page, go to the Overview tab and fill in the information. If you need to add more fields, you can customize them through the Settings menu at the top right. Now, let's explore the Web Tech Pack features in Closet. In the BOM tab, the data created in Closet will be automatically synced. You can add more detailed descriptions and fill in any missing information by selecting Add a Blank Row. Click the plus button at the top right to add a content row for each item. In the POM tab, data from Closet is also automatically synced. You can add how to measure instructions and define tolerance values. If any If any information is missing, you can add additional rows to complete it. In the Cost Estimation tab, the material costs entered earlier are automatically calculated. You can also include additional costs such as transportation, labor, or other expenses to estimate the total cost. Once all information is completed, return to the Overview tab and click the Export button at the top right to download the tech pack. Select the information you want to include, choose the file format and colorway, and download the file. Finally, go back to the line sheet and enter the sales-related information. You can manage your sales plan by adding details such as retail intro date, retail exit date, pricing, and sales channels.
markdown_content: ## Overview: Prepare a Design for Production Using Web Techpack (Clo-Set + WebTechPak) This workflow explains how to prepare a design for production by entering production data in Clo-Set/WebTechPak, exporting a tech pack, and completing sales information on the line sheet. It covers POM creation, seam allowance setup, print layout nesting, BOM synchronization, cost estimation, tech pack export, and sales planning fields. ## Step 1: Enter Required Data in Clo-Set/WebTechPak (2D Setup) This section covers creating the POM (point of measure) and verifying it in the 3D viewer within the 2D environment. 1. Open the necessary data entry area in the Clo-Set/WebTechPak workflow. 2. In the **2D viewer**, select **Monochrome surface**. 3. Click the **Point of Measure (POM)** button on the **right panel**. 4. Enter a **description for the POM**. 5. Select the **measurement points directly on the pattern**. 6. (Optional verification) Activate the **3D window** in the **bottom right** to confirm the created POM is displayed correctly on the **3D garment**. ## Step 2: Configure Seam Allowance and Seam Type This section describes how to input seam allowance details by selecting the correct pattern area, setting width, and defining seam type. 1. Select **Seam Allowance** to input seam allowance information. 2. Choose the **pattern**. 3. Adjust the **width value** for the selected area. 4. Define the **seam type** for that area. ## Step 3: Switch to Print Layout and Run Nesting This section explains how to generate efficient marker paper layouts by running nesting and checking fabric consumption. 1. Switch to **Print Layout**. 2. Perform **nesting** to align marker paper efficiently. 3. Adjust **Nest Settings** as needed. 4. Click **Nest Patterns All**. 5. Review the results to **check fabric consumption**. ## Step 4: Build Bill of Materials (BOM) and Enter Material Costs This section covers moving to the production workflow, selecting **Build**, and entering unit prices for each material. 1. Go to the **Production** tab at the top. 2. Select **Build** (build materials). 3. For each material, **enter the unit price**. 4. After completing all inputs, **upload the version to Clo-Set**. ## Step 5: Complete Tech Pack Content in Clo-Set (Overview, BOM, POM, Cost Estimation) This section explains how Clo-Set automatically syncs BOM and POM data, how to add missing fields/rows, and how to calculate costs. ### Overview Tab (Fill Content + Customize Fields) 1. In Clo-Set, open the **Content page**. 2. Go to the **Overview** tab and fill in the required information. 3. If additional fields are needed, use the **Settings** menu (top right) to **customize fields**. ### BOM Tab (Synced Materials + Add Rows) 1. Open the **BOM** tab. 2. The BOM data created earlier is **automatically synced** from Clo-Set/WebTechPak. 3. Add missing or more detailed information by selecting **Add a Blank Row**. 4. Use the **plus button** (top right) to add a **content row for each item**. ### POM Tab (Synced Measurement Instructions + Tolerances) 1. Open the **POM** tab. 2. POM data is also **automatically synced**. 3. Add **how-to-measure instructions**. 4. Define **tolerance values**. 5. If information is missing, add additional rows to complete it. ### Cost Estimation Tab (Auto-Calculated Materials + Additional Costs) 1. Open the **Cost Estimation** tab. 2. Material costs entered earlier are **automatically calculated**. 3. Add additional costs such as: - **Transportation** - **Labor** - **Other expenses** 4. Use these to estimate the **total cost**. ## Step 6: Export the Tech Pack This section explains exporting the completed tech pack from the Overview tab by selecting included information, file format, and colorway. 1. Return to the **Overview** tab. 2. Click **Export** (top right). 3. Select: - The **information** you want to include - The **file format** - The **colorway** 4. Download the exported tech pack file. ## Step 7: Enter Sales Information on the Line Sheet This section covers adding sales plan fields such as dates, pricing, and sales channels. 1. Go back to the **Line Sheet**. 2. Enter **sales-related information**. 3. Manage the sales plan by adding details including: - **Retail intro date** - **Retail exit date** - **Pricing** - **Sales channels**
